summary: Describes a set of mappings between X.400 mail systems and systems using the RFC 822 mail format. X.400 was a CCITT standard for store-and-forward messaging, and these mappings let the two worlds interwork. It was a proposed protocol, was updated by RFC 1026, RFC 1138 and RFC 1148, and was replaced by RFC 1327 and RFC 2156.

eli5.summary: Two countries use different postal forms. This memo is the translation table that lets a letter written on one form be understood when it arrives in the other.

questions: how to map x.400 to rfc 822
how do x.400 and internet email interoperate
